summary: Tests-only phase for issue #39 (adopt generated OpenAPI client + solver parity corpus). Committed: (1) byte-identical copy of the upstream parity corpus (viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, algorithm_version 1, 12 scenarios, sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) at ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/Fixtures/parity-v1-corpus.json; (2) SolverParityCorpusTests.swift replaying every scenario through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer (score table, exclusions, earliest-wins selection, tie_broke/tied_indices evidence, error, hex) plus CompositionSolver 1x1-grid fast-path replay for the 11 grid-expressible scenarios; (3) PaletteAPIClientWireContractTests.swift pinning the /api/v1 wire behavior the generated-client migration must preserve (endpoint paths, query, headers, envelope decoding incl. additive-field tolerance, 401/5xx/malformed error mapping, testConnection, and the client->ProfileColorCache offline-fallback seam); (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md. Overall status is 'skipped' solely because swift test cannot execute in this container (no Swift toolchain); the repo's own bin/lint also detects this and exits 0 with a skip notice. Corpus agreement was independently cross-verified by an equivalent Python replay of the scorer semantics over the committed fixture: all 12 scenarios, 60 score-table entries, 5 tie cases, 4 exclusion scenarios, and 2 no-selection scenarios match exactly. The committed Swift tests must be confirmed green on a Swift host (cd ColorComposerCore && swift test) before merge. Upstream research recorded for the PR body: OpenAPI spec is served dynamically at GET /api/v1/openapi.json (viamin/color_matching#113, open_api_spex + CastAndValidate + Schemathesis/oasdiff CI) with no static spec file committed upstream, so the Swift package must export the document from a running server to drive swift-openapi-generator; corpus is generated by mix parity.generate and byte-guarded in server CI (viamin/color_matching#112).

acceptance_criteria.description: Add swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime to ColorComposerCore, generate typed client from the OpenAPI document, migrate (or wrap) PaletteAPIClient

verification.evidence: Implementation is out of scope for this tests-only phase (Package.swift is outside the test-path allowlist). The migration's behavioral contract is now pinned by ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/PaletteAPIClientWireContractTests.swift: endpoint paths and query (testFetchPrinterProfilesRequestsTheVersionedEndpoint, testFetchColorsRequestsTheVersionedEndpointWithProfileQuery), headers incl. token normalization (testWhitespaceOnlyTokenOmitsTheAuthorizationHeader; existing PaletteAPIClientTests covers trimmed tokens and 401), envelope decoding with additive-spec-field tolerance (testFetchColorsDecodesColorsAndProfileEnvelope, testDecodingToleratesAdditiveSpecFieldsAndUnknownLightSources), and error mapping (testServerErrorMapsToBadStatus, testUndecodableSuccessBodyMapsToMalformedResponse, testUnauthorizedAppliesToColorsFetchToo). Notes for the implementation run: upstream serves the spec dynamically at GET /api/v1/openapi.json (no static file committed in viamin/color_matching#113); assertions deliberately do not pin httpMethod, which a generated client sets explicitly.

acceptance_criteria.description: Preserve existing behavior: per-server/profile color caching, offline-stale badges, cached profile fallback

verification.evidence: Disk cache and offline fallback are already exhaustively pinned by the committed ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/ProfileColorCacheTests.swift (60+ tests: per-(server,profile) namespacing, snake_case on-disk format guard, corrupt/symlink/foreign-file misses, removeAll semantics). This run adds the client->cache seam test testFetchedColorsRoundTripThroughTheDiskCacheForOfflineFallback, which fetches via the mocked API, stores through ProfileColorCache, and asserts the offline entry serves identical wire DTOs and solver-ready domain colors (unmeasured channels stay absent, never zero). Offline-stale badge UI (AppModel) is app-level and unchanged by the migration; not re-testable in the core package. None executable in this container (no Swift toolchain); must run via cd ColorComposerCore && swift test on CI/macOS.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add a solver parity test target in ColorComposerCore tests that loads the committed corpus and asserts WeightedSquaredErrorScorer selections match expected outputs exactly, including tie cases

verification.evidence: SolverParityCorpusTests.swift + byte-identical corpus fixture committed. Tests: (a) corpus contract metadata + coverage floors (>=12 scenarios, >=5 ties, >=4 exclusion scenarios, >=2 no-selection); (b) exact per-candidate score-table parity incl. 'excluded' entries; (c) exact selection/tie_broke/tied_indices/error/hex parity with earliest-index-wins; (d) CompositionSolver 1x1-grid fast-path replay for all 11 grid-expressible scenarios incl. excluded-candidate counts. Swift execution blocked in this container (no toolchain). Supporting external evidence: an equivalent Python replay of WeightedSquaredErrorScorer semantics over the committed fixture reports 'ALL CORPUS EXPECTATIONS MATCH SWIFT SCORER SEMANTICS' (scenarios=12 tie=5 with_exclusions=4 no_selection=2 solver_replayable=11), so the committed expectations are consistent with the Swift scorer as implemented and the suite is expected green on a Swift host.

acceptance_criteria.description: Document corpus consumption in the README (where the corpus lives, how to refresh it)
acceptance_criteria.reason: README.md is outside this phase's allowlist (tests + docs/ + LID docs only). Canonical documentation committed at docs/solver-parity-corpus.md covering upstream location (priv/parity/v1/corpus.json), the byte-identical committed copy, how the tests consume it, refresh procedure, and algorithm_version bump rules. The implementation run must add the README section linking this doc.

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records: generated-client migration notes, any /api/v1 shape changes found, parity test results

verification.evidence: Findings recorded durably for the PR body: (1) /api/v1 shape: no breaking shape changes found; spec published dynamically at GET /api/v1/openapi.json by open_api_spex with request/response validation and Schemathesis/oasdiff CI (viamin/color_matching#113); no static spec file upstream, so codegen requires exporting the document from a running server; the client's hand-written DTOs match the current envelope shapes and the new wire tests pin additive-field tolerance. (2) Parity results: 12/12 scenarios match WeightedSquaredErrorScorer exactly (5 tie scenarios resolve earliest-index-wins, 4 exclusion scenarios confirm missing-never-zero, unknown weight keys ignored, weights scale errors linearly); recorded in docs/solver-parity-corpus.md 'Parity findings at adoption (algorithm_version 1)'. (3) Migration notes for the implementation run are in AC-1's evidence.
